contract: Additive error_code and error_params on REST error bodies and channel error replies. Existing fields and statuses remain unchanged. params maps required parameter names to JSON Schema types; an empty map means no parameters. No other parameters are emitted. Sources are route/event families, not a promise that every code occurs on every member of a family.
field_errors: Optional parallel array of {field: string, error_code: string, error_params: object}. Field is the original field name or dotted room-config path. Legacy errors are unchanged. Unknown validators and Room.Config messages without validator metadata use field_invalid; never infer codes from English messages.

inventory.legacy: {errors: [{code, title, detail, ...}]} or {error: SEAT_REQUIRES_GAMES, min_games, games_played}
inventory.codes: Explicit domain codes retained, lowercase in additive error_code. Unknown atoms retain legacy uppercase code but use request_failed.

inventory.legacy: {errors: [{code: RATE_LIMITED, title, detail}]} plus Retry-After header

inventory.codes: Lowercase equivalent. Blocked pairs still receive user_not_found or seat_taken; no new code reveals a block.
Previously uncoded; explicit avatar reason mapping.

inventory.legacy: {reason: English or stable reason string, readiness?: object, seat_lifecycle?: object}

inventory.codes: Known domain reasons; action_failed for unknown failures.

gaps: Socket connection rejection remains bare :error (no JSON reply).
Missing public avatar remains an empty 404 response.
Deferred invite misses remain successful 200 data.invite=null.
HTML/admin errors, engine strings and all broadcasts are outside this contract.
Room.Config validators and custom Ecto errors without metadata use field_invalid with their original field identity.
